title: Cree LED Introduces XLamp X21 Multi-Color LEDs, A New Platform for Smaller, Lighter, and More Impactful Lighting Designs
summary: Cree LED ®, a Penguin Solutions brand (Nasdaq: PENG ), today announced the launch of XLamp® X21 Multi-Color LEDs, a new 4-color LED platform innovation that combines an ultra-compact footprint, exceptional optical performance, and extensive color flexibility to help lighting manufacturers create smaller, lighter, and more impactful lighting products. Cree LED XLamp X21 Multi-Color LEDs Leveraging Cree LED's latest multi-color LED technology, XLamp X21 Multi-Color LEDs feature four different colors of LED die placed close together in a compact 2.1 x 2.1 mm ceramic package, making them the smallest ceramic multi-color LEDs in Cree LED's portfolio. The smaller optical source enables lighting manufacturers to reduce luminaire size and weight while maintaining the beam quality and visual performance demands of indoor directional, architectural, entertainment, automotive, and specialty lighting applications.
